journey.name: Workout history
journey.description: Plan a workout from the first run, end a workout after its first round, find it in History and open it, then clear History. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the screen shows "Train to a plan"
Verify that the screen shows "Weekly goal" and a "Routine" row for each weekday
Verify that the weekly goal shows 3
Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" says "1 of 8 rounds done"
Verify that the summary shows "Ended" and "Saved to history"
Verify that "Week" is picked, "This week" reads "2 more to hit 3" with a 1/3 ring, and a "Today" section lists one workout
Verify that its page shows "ended early", "Repeat now" and "Plan again"
Verify that a calendar of this month shows today marked done
Verify that a dialog titled "Clear history?" is shown
Verify that the screen is back to "Train to a plan": with no workouts and nothing planned, History starts over
